title: GuideHollow production-browser QA: reproducible exercises and limits
scope: Actual public GuideHollow website interacted with by a browser agent. Underlying sample sales, garden, release and event data are invented. No Excel, Google Sheets, ChatGPT or external AI model was executed.
method: Live browser UI interaction and reading rendered results; not only source-code inspection. Separate Node regression tests are published in the repository.

trials.limits: Data are fictional and amounts have no verified currency.
The new calculated weighted average is a display rounded to two decimals.

observed.error: Row 8: UnitPrice must be a nonnegative number; blanks are not zero.
observed.summary: No result: correct the input and try again.

trials.limits: Demonstrates local input validation, not accounting compliance.

observed.g04Reason: The meeting location is not confirmed.

trials.limits: The initial browser run did not preserve checked radio inputs; the 1/5 score could reflect incomplete selection rather than a scoring defect. The five stated planned answers would score 4/5 under the reference key. A separate post-fix browser run confirmed that submitting only one of five selected answers is blocked; complete five-answer browser scoring was not repeated.

trials.input: Post-fix five-case practice: select only G04=SUPPORTED; leave four other questions unanswered; press Check my source-reading answers once.

observed.selectionStatus: 1 of 5 claims answered. Read the source and select one verdict for each claim before grading.
observed.submitStatus: Only 1 of 5 claims answered. Select a verdict for every claim before grading.

trials.limits: Narrow post-fix UI smoke test of an incomplete five-case submission. Does not validate every browser or that the complete five-answer submission scores 4/5 in a browser. A source-level regression separately checks that deterministic score.
